purpose: Teach: 問いかけ/たどっ/潰れ/壊さ/敷い/歪ん/聞き取れ/消さ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、自らへの問いかけ、深く書きましたね。
lines.en: Your paper shows real depth in the self-questioning and reflection.
lines.style: Warm, measured appraisal. Steady eye contact. Pausing slightly before each key observation, letting the weight land. Not rushing — a teacher who reads what she's praising.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究をたどった上で、新規性、出しました。
lines.en: Yes. I worked through the prior research carefully before establishing what's actually new.
lines.style: Quiet, methodical confidence. Speaking as someone who did the work and knows it. No apology in the tone, but not boastful either — factual pride.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 実験で潰れたサンプル、考察も、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: And your analysis of the failed samples was really thoughtful — you didn't just dismiss them.
lines.style: Leaning in slightly, genuine interest in the voice. A teacher noticing the care in the details. Slower pace on the second clause, showing she's really thinking about what was done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 環境を壊さずに、研究を進める姿勢、章にしました。
lines.en: I made it a whole chapter — the idea that research should move forward without destroying the environment.
lines.style: Speaking from conviction, not defensiveness. Steady rhythm, building slightly. Shows this wasn't an afterthought but a conscious choice woven through the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 敷いた前提、適切でしたね。
lines.en: The foundational assumptions you laid out were exactly right for this.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Calm, unhurried. The kind of teacher who doesn't praise loosely — when she says something is right, she means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: データが歪んでない、確認、徹底しました。
lines.en: I was rigorous about checking that the data wasn't distorted anywhere.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly formal. Not boasting — just stating what was done. The voice of someone who knows that rigor matters and won't downplay it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 専門用語、聞き取れない学生にも、配慮ありますね。
lines.en: I noticed you made the jargon accessible too — even students who might not catch all the terms could follow the thinking.
lines.style: Warm recognition, slight surprise in the best way. Speaking as a teacher who's seen too much writing that forgets the reader. Thoughtful, not patronizing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 引用を消さず、明示する姿勢、貫きました。
lines.en: I kept every citation visible, made it explicit where the ideas came from. That was important to me.
lines.style: Firm, clear, almost quiet conviction. No equivocation. A student stating something he did because it mattered, not because he was told to. Slight intensity beneath the surface.
